Nice — that'll do the job. Sixteen ports, fanless, and it'll take the BC04 plus whatever comes next without you thinking about it again.

Plug it in and get those shares landing.
is it better than previous one I am not sure. A didn't decide which one to buy.

Same family, just bigger — the GS116Ev2 is the 16-port version of the GS308E, same smart features, same fanless metal case. Only real difference is ports and price.

Eight is plenty for one miner and a switch you'll grow into. Buy on price.
Cisco Meraki MS120-8-HW is better choice probably.

I'd steer off that one. Meraki needs a paid cloud licence per switch, and when the licence lapses the switch stops passing traffic — it bricks itself. Fine in an office with a budget line, bad for a miner in the corner.

The N. keeps working forever with nothing to renew. Stick with it.

It's a layer 2 switch, so IPv6 traffic passes through untouched — your miner and anything else get v6 fine from the router.

The only limit is the switch's own management page, which is IPv4-only on the Plus models. Doesn't affect what's plugged into it.
